Title: 1. Add product to cart with a logged out user
Preconditions:
1. User is logged out
2. Product is in stock
3. User is on view product details screen
Steps: 1. Add a single product to cart from product details screen
Expected result:
1. Product would be added to the cart successfully 
2. A confirmation message would be displayed with:
"Product have been added to the cart"

Title: 2. Add product to cart with a logged in user
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in
2. Product is in stock
Steps: 1. Add 30 different product to cart from the search results list
Expected result:
1. Product would be added to the cart successfully 
2. A confirmation message would be displayed with:
"Product have been added to the cart"

Title: 3. Login after adding products to cart while the user was logged out

2. Product is in stock
